title: Adversarial Fine-Tuning of Language Models: An Iterative Optimisation Approach for the Generation and Detection of Problematic Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification accuracy, precision, recall, and AUROC of a judge model on a curated hold-out dataset of human-annotated problematic versus unproblematic prompts, as well as measuring transferability by predicting the 'toxic' label on the Kaggle Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification test set.
